title: Brazil Gears Up for Oct. 4 Vote With Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro as Main Contenders
detail: With Brazil's October 4 presidential vote days away, coverage of the race centers on incumbent President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro — not his imprisoned father Jair Bolsonaro, who remains barred from office until 2030 — as the two leading contenders. The race is a rematch in spirit of 2022, with Flávio running as the standard-bearer of Bolsonarismo and both campaigns mobilizing bases ahead of the vote.

media.caption: Brazil's Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remain essentially tied ahead of the October 4 vote
